title: awaiting/2 docstring promises a seed fallback that the code does not implement
detail: Docstring says a missing key falls back to the seed; the implementation returns an empty list. Behaviour is fine (seed() always populates the key), only the comment is wrong.
recommended_fix: Reword the docstring to 'returns [] when the vacancy has no awaiting rows' to match awaiting_for.

title: Fix-6 audit claim of zero `grace` hits in demo code is inaccurate — comments and a test docstring still contain 'a-grace'
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:    // Purged a-grace id -> a-grainne.
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:    // Purged a-grace id -> a-grainne; doc ids kept stable.
client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam:/// Fix 6: the a-grace residue is purged to the grainne id — the store serves
client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam:/// an "a-grainne" applicant and no "a-grace" id remains anywhere.
detail: rg -i grace over client/src/demo, client/test/demo and server/src/demo returns 4 hits, all in comments/docstrings. No live id references remain and all 626 client tests pass, so the purge is functionally complete — only the 'zero grep hits' audit claim is false.
recommended_fix: Either drop the 'a-grace' mentions from the comments, or correct the audit claim to 'zero live id references; comments documenting the purge remain'.

title: demo_store.remind_applicant reports #(0, 1) (follow-up sent) for an email not in the pool, mutating nothing
detail: sent_reminded is False both when the row is already reminded AND when the email is absent from rows; the latter returns #(0,1) so the toast claims a follow-up was sent with no state change. Unreachable from the UI (awaiting_section only renders the button for !reminded or followup_due rows) but contradicts the docstring's 0,0 parity case.
recommended_fix: Compute membership separately: if the email is not found return #(store, #(0, 0)) so the 'already had both reminders' defensive copy fires instead of a phantom follow-up.
